name: demo-prompt
description: No tools; one prompt, summarise_gene, to see how a prompt appears in the host's menu.

interface.shortDescription: One canned prompt, picked by the user, not the model.
interface.longDescription: No tools, one MCP prompt, summarise_gene, that asks for a three-bullet cancer-biology summary of a gene. Prompts are picked by a person from the host's menu (a slash command in Claude Code), never invoked by the model on its own.
defaultPrompt: Run the summarise_gene prompt for TP53.
